rows.resolution_note: Rule C: sentence 2 of p001 defines the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data by more than a number of participants (2,923 plasma proteins measured in 51,296 non-demented middle-aged adults with 15 years of follow-up; sentence 3 adds the Cox proportional hazard models); no accession, citation or release of a published UK Biobank GWAS is given, so no dictionary row is identified.
rows.quote: Methods We used data of 2,923 plasma proteins from 51,296 non‐demented middle‐aged adults in the UK Biobank with 15 years of follow‐up.
